dog.description_text:
⚖️ 7.2 pounds
🐾 Potential Hound Mix
Mary is a happy, fun-loving puppy who enjoys playing with everyone! She's great with cats and dogs, both young and old, and absolutely LOVES toys, treats, and lots of affection! 🥰
This little girl has a healthy appetite and enjoys both wet and dry food. She's just beginning her potty-training journey, but she's only a baby and learning more every day!
Mary is ready for a lifetime of puppy kisses, cuddles, playtime, and adventures with her very own forever family! 🏡❤️
dog.name: Mary
